question: How can I connect my mobile device to the TV?
answer:
To connect your mobile device to the TV:

- Connect your mobile device and TV to the same network [1].
- Use the SmartThings app on your mobile device to connect to the TV and control its main settings [1].
- Make sure your TV supports SmartThings by checking the Supported Device menu in the SmartThings app [1].
- You must be signed in to your Samsung account on the TV to use the SmartThings app [1].
- You can install the SmartThings app from the App Store or Google Play Store [1].
- Turn on the TV, start the SmartThings app on your mobile device, tap **Add Device** on the dashboard, select your TV model from the search results, and enter the PIN number displayed on the TV screen [2].
- Once the TV is registered with your Samsung account, you can use the SmartThings app to control the TV [2].
- If your TV is not found, turn both devices off and on, then try again [2].
- If you have more than one TV, you can set different TV names at **Settings > General > System Manager > Device Name** to select the TV you want [2].
- For Smart View, the mobile device must support a mirroring function such as Screen Mirroring or Smart View, and the mobile device and Smart TV must be connected on the same network [5].

question: How do I set scheduled viewing time?
answer:
To set scheduled viewing time, first set the TV’s clock via **Settings > General > System Manager > Time > Clock** [1][3]. Then use one of these methods:

- **From the Guide screen:** select the program you want to view, press and hold the **Select** button, and select **Schedule Viewing** from the pop-up menu [1][2].
- **From the Program Info screen:** press **Select** while watching TV, use the left/right directional buttons to select a broadcast scheduled program, press **Select**, and select **Schedule Viewing** [1][2][4].
- **For a specified date/time:** go to **Live TV > Schedule Manager > Add Viewing** (U.S.A. and Canada) or **Live TV > Schedule Manager > Recordings > Schedules > Add Viewing** (other countries), then set **Antenna**, **Channel**, **Repeat**, **Date**, and **Start Time**, and select **Save** [2].

This function may not be supported depending on the model or geographical area [2].

question: Can I scan TV for malicious code ?
answer: Yes. You can scan the TV and connected storage for malicious code via **Settings > General > System Manager > Smart Security > Scan** [1]. If malicious code is found, the scan results appear on the screen, and you can quarantine (isolate) the code [1]. Smart Security can also protect the TV from hacking and malicious code when it is connected to the Internet [2].

question: What is decor and how to set wallpaper of the Ambient Mode screen?
answer:
Decor is an Ambient Mode category that “allows you to select beautiful screens” [1].

To set a picture as the wallpaper of the Ambient Mode screen, use the **Photo** category: it “allows you to set a picture stored in your mobile device as the wallpaper of the Ambient Mode screen,” and you can configure special layouts using your photos. To save photos from your mobile device to the TV and import them in Ambient Mode, use the **SmartThings** app on your mobile device. In the Ambient Mode browser screen, use the left or right directional buttons in the content list to move focus to the content you want, then press **Select**; the selected content is played in Ambient Mode [1].

question: From where I can see program information?
answer:
You can see program information in the **Program Info window** by pressing **Select** while watching a program/TV; the window displays program details [1][2][3].  
You can also see an overview of each channel’s program lineup in **Viewing Broadcast Information at a Glance** [4], and check programs on other digital channels via the **Channel List** [5].

question: What is source and how to serch data for channels?
answer:
**Source:** The **Source** screen is used to select a connected external device; when selected, that device’s output is displayed on the TV [4]. It is also used to select a device with media content, after which the device’s media content list appears [2].

**How to search/scan for channels:** Use **Settings > Broadcasting > Auto Program** [5]. The **All Channels** list displays the channels the TV found during the Auto Program channel search [3]. Do **not** use Auto Program if the TV is connected to a cable box or satellite box [5].

question: How can I change Antenna type?
answer: Open **Live TV Channel List**, press the **right directional button** on the remote, move the focus to **Air / Cable**, and then press **Select** [1][4]. question: How can I connect my mobile device to the TV?
answer:

question: How can I view the channels that are serached by auto program function and How can I view first five favorite channel?
answer:
To view the channels found by the Auto Program function: open the **Channel List**, press the **right directional button**, and select **All Channels**; this displays the channels the TV found during the Auto Program channel search [2].

To view the favorite lists: on the **Live TV Channel List**, press the **right directional button**, select **Favorites**, then choose the desired list among the **five favorites lists**; the channels in the selected favorites list appear, and only favorites lists that contain registered channels will display channels [3]. The TV allows up to five favorites lists [1], and the Favorites menu displays **Favorites 1** through **Favorites 5** [2].

question: How do I fix blurring issues on TV screen?
answer:
1. Run **Start Picture Test** to determine whether the blurring is caused by the TV: **Settings > Support > Self Diagnosis > Start Picture Test** [1].  
2. If you notice **ghosting or blurring**, use **Auto Motion Plus Settings**: **Settings > Picture > Expert Settings > Auto Motion Plus Settings** [1].  
3. If blurred edges are caused by colors, set **Grayscale**: **Settings > General > Accessibility > Grayscale** [5].  
4. If the test indicates the problem is not caused by the TV, check that the video input connectors are connected to the correct external device video output connectors [1].

question: How to launch the last used app automatically?
answer: To launch the last used app automatically, set **Settings > General > Smart Features > Autorun Last App**. You can turn this function on or off by pressing the **Select** button at the current menu; when enabled, the last used app automatically runs when you turn on the TV [1]. This function may not be supported depending on the app [1].

question: I want to setup a  beautiful screens. How can I do that?
answer:
To set up “beautiful screens,” use **Ambient Mode** and choose the **Decor** category. **Decor** “Allows you to select beautiful screens” [1]. Ambient Mode lets you view beautiful screens, visual information, and notifications [5].

Steps:
1. Enter **Ambient Mode** by pressing the button described in the guide [5].
2. In the **Ambient Mode browser screen**, use the left/right directional buttons in the content list at the top to move focus to the content you want, then press **Select** [1].
3. Select **Decor** to choose beautiful screens [1].
4. You can also change Ambient Mode settings such as **Brightness**, **Color Tone**, **Auto Brightness**, and **Ambient Off Timer** [1].
5. To change the background color or pattern, move focus to the relevant item in the Ambient Mode browser screen and press **Select**, then choose a color or pattern [1].

Note: Ambient Mode is a QLED TV-specific function and may not be supported depending on the model [5].

question: How can I connect my mobile device to the TV?
answer:
To connect your mobile device to the TV:

1. Connect your mobile device and the TV to the same network [1][4].  
2. Make sure your TV supports SmartThings; you can check this with the Supported Device menu in the SmartThings app [1].  
3. Make sure you are signed in to your Samsung account on the TV [1].  
4. Install the SmartThings app from the App Store or Google Play Store [1].  
5. Turn on the TV, start the SmartThings app on your mobile device, tap **Add Device** on the dashboard, select your TV model from the search results, and enter the PIN number displayed on the TV screen [2].  
6. Once the TV is registered with your Samsung account, you can use the SmartThings app to control the TV [2].  
7. If your TV is not found, turn both devices off and on, then try again [2].  
8. If you have more than one TV, you can set different TV names to select the TV you want [2].  

For Smart View, the mobile device must support a mirroring function such as Screen Mirroring or Smart View [4]. For Wi-Fi Direct, the mobile device must support Wi-Fi Direct [4].

question: How do I view a list of mobile devices registered to the TV?
answer: Go to **Settings > General > External Device Manager > Device Connect Manager**, then select **Device List** to view, edit, or remove the mobile devices registered to the TV [1].

question: Can I scan TV for malicious code ?
answer: Yes. You can scan the TV and connected storage for malicious code via **Settings > General > System Manager > Smart Security > Scan** [1]. If malicious code is found, the scan results appear on the screen, and you can quarantine (isolate) the selected malicious code to prevent it from executing [1]. Smart Security can also protect the TV from hacking and malicious code when it is connected to the Internet [2].

question: How do I set scheduled viewing time?
answer:
To set a scheduled viewing time, first set the TV’s clock via **Settings > General > System Manager > Time > Clock** [1][2][3].

You can then schedule viewing by:

- On the **Guide** screen, select a program, press and hold **Select**, then choose **Schedule Viewing** [2][3].
- While watching TV, press **Select** to open the **Program Info** window, select a broadcast scheduled program with the left/right buttons, press **Select**, then choose **Schedule Viewing** [2][3].
- Using **Live TV > Schedule Manager > Add Viewing** (U.S.A. and Canada), or **Live TV > Schedule Manager > Recordings > Schedules > Add Viewing** (other countries), set **Antenna, Channel, Repeat, Date, and Start Time**, then select **Save** [3].

Check the current time in **Settings > General > System Manager > Time > Clock** [3]. This function may not be supported depending on the model or geographical area [3].

question: Can I request service I am having problem with the TV?

Your service request will be registered, and the Samsung Contact Center will contact you to set up or confirm your service appointment [1][2]. You must agree to the terms and conditions, and this function requires an Internet connection; it may not be supported depending on the geographical area [1][2].

question: What is decor and how to set wallpaper of the Ambient Mode screen?
answer:
**Decor** is a category in the Ambient Mode browser that “allows you to select beautiful screens” [1].

To set a wallpaper for the Ambient Mode screen:
1. In Ambient Mode, press the button to open the Ambient Mode browser screen [1].
2. In the content list at the top, use the left/right directional buttons to move to the desired content, then press **Select** [1].
3. Select **Photo**, which “allows you to set a picture stored in your mobile device as the wallpaper of the Ambient Mode screen” and lets you configure special layouts using your photos [1].
4. To save photos from your mobile device to the TV and import them in Ambient Mode, use the **SmartThings** app on your mobile device [1].

question: How can I change Antenna type?
answer: To change the antenna/broadcast signal type, in **Live TV Channel List**, press the **right directional button** on your remote, move the focus to **Air / Cable**, and press **Select** [5]. This lets you select **Air** or **Cable** as the DTV mode: **Air** is for homes with separate over-the-air antennas, and **Cable** is for homes with local cable service [3]. You do not need this function if your TV is connected to a cable box or satellite box [3][5].
